what_differs: The client agreed that on confirmed fraud a Write-off checkbox is set when Payment Sent is checked, and a New record moves to Archived when it is not. Jira records this only as 'New scope added' in a comment on WAGR-165, which is Done, and WAGR-466 (2026-09-25) says no write-off capability exists today.
suggested_action: Open a build ticket (or reopen WAGR-165) for the Write-off checkbox and the confirm-fraud automation, and link it to WAGR-220 and WAGR-466. Confirm in the sandbox whether any of it was built.
